content.title: About
content.content: Roll "White Soft" (item 2416) is a delicate bread roll made from wheat flour, milk, butter and a touch of sugar. It has a soft, airy crumb and a mild sweet note, making it perfect for breakfasts, snacks, and as a base for various fillings.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: White soft rolls are commonly used in traditional Eastern European dishes such as open‑face sandwiches and canapés.
The dough is usually given a proofing period, which creates the characteristic porous texture.
The original recipe uses butter rather than vegetable oils, giving it a distinctive aroma.
When kept in a sealed package, the rolls stay fresh for 3–5 days at room temperature.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: The roll provides a quick source of energy thanks to easily digestible carbs.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: It supplies thiamine, riboflavin and niacin, which support metabolism.

items.title: Contains calcium
items.content: Milk and butter add a modest amount of calcium beneficial for bones.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: The roll contains wheat flour and is unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Because of its simple carbs, the roll can raise blood sugar levels quickly.

items.title: Sugar and fat content
items.content: For those monitoring weight, moderate consumption is advised due to added sugar and butter.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: White soft rolls can be eaten fresh, sliced and spread with butter, jam, cream cheese, or used as a base for sandwiches with ham, cheese, and vegetables.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store rolls in an airtight bag at room temperature for up to 5 days. For longer storage keep them in the refrigerator (up to 10 days) or freeze (up to 3 months). Allow them to come to room temperature before serving.
